scope: Production Chromium against local Vite preview and authenticated synthetic GET responses. Each fresh browser context has cold HTTP cache; subsequent filters/diagnostic opening are warm. Browser event-to-two-requestAnimationFrame latency includes browser layout/paint scheduling and Playwright readiness round trips. Separate instrumentation localizes JSON.stringify work and is excluded from browser latency samples. One natural 30-second task-list poll per uninstrumented context is observed; no clock/timer acceleration. Not HTTP-service, real model, WebView, Android, or typical-provenance throughput evidence.

browser.assertions: Pydantic-valid fixed DTOs; 20-record pagination; exact diagnostic JSON before/after parent filters and task refresh; 1,000-record search; supplied-null answers; authenticated GET-only/no model mutations
